definitions.def: a great many; very many in number
to bring a memory back into your mind
a mental connection between ideas or things

grammar_choice.en_template: Do you always {{1:study/studying}} in the same {{2:spot/spots}}?
If you study in different places, that helps {{1:create/created}} variety, and that rich experience can {{2:reinforce/reinforcing}} what you are learning.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 당신이 여러 다른 장소에서 공부하면, 그것은 다양성을 만들어 내는 데 도움이 되고, 그 풍부한 경험은 당신이 배우고 있는 것을 강화할 수 있다.

grammar_choice.en_template: When several college students told us they did school work in different places {{1:rather than/rather as}} in some favorite nook, that habit {{2:reflected/reflecting}} the research on learning.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 여러 대학생들이 우리에게 그들이 어떤 좋아하는 구석진 곳이 아니라 다른 여러 장소에서 학업을 한다고 말했을 때, 그 습관은 학습에 관한 연구를 반영한 것이었다.
explain: A rather than B — "B가 아니라 A".

grammar_choice.en_template: Numerous experiments have found that if learners simply study in at least two different places, they are more {{1:likely/like}} to {{2:recall/recalling}} the material.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 수많은 실험은 학습자가 단지 적어도 두 곳의 다른 장소에서 공부하기만 해도, 그들이 학습 자료를 기억할 가능성이 더 높다는 것을 발견했다.
explain: be more likely to V — "~할 가능성이 더 높다".

grammar_choice.en_template: In {{1:one/ones}} of the first such trials, two different groups {{2:studied/study}} a list of words.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 그러한 최초의 실험들 중 하나에서, 두 개의 다른 집단이 단어 목록을 공부했다.

grammar_choice.en_template: Some students returned to the same room twice {{1:while/during}} their counterparts spent the same amount of time {{2:divided/dividing}} between two locations.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 어떤 학생들은 같은 방으로 두 번 돌아온 반면, 그들의 상대편은 같은 양의 시간을 두 장소에 나누어 보냈다.
explain: 절을 이끄는 접속사 while(반면에); during은 전치사라 불가.

grammar_choice.en_template: When {{1:asked/asking}} to recall as many words on the list as possible, those {{2:who/which}} had moved around did far better.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 목록에 있는 가능한 한 많은 단어를 기억해 내라고 했을 때, 이리저리 옮겨 다닌 학생들이 훨씬 더 잘했다.
explain: 분사구문 When (being) asked — 수동 과거분사 asked.

grammar_choice.ko_full: 다양성은 풍부한 연상을 만들어 내며, 그 연결이 우리가 의식적으로 생각하는 것 밖에서 배경처럼 형성될 때조차 그러하다.

jumble.answer: Do you always study in the same spot?
If you study in different places, that helps create variety, and that rich experience can reinforce what you are learning.
When several college students told us they did school work in different places rather than in some favorite nook, that habit reflected the research on learning.
Numerous experiments have found that if learners simply study in at least two different places, they are more likely to recall the material.
In one of the first such trials, two different groups studied a list of words.
Some students returned to the same room twice while their counterparts spent the same amount of time divided between two locations.
When asked to recall as many words on the list as possible, those who had moved around did far better.
Variety creates rich association, even when those connections form in the background, totally outside of what we are consciously thinking.
